Title: Storm Research: A Systems-Thinking Operating Frame for Solving Any Problem (v2 verified)
Summary: Verified research briefing (2026-08-05): 5-lens synthesis (practitioner, academic, skeptic, economist, historian) on problem-solving frameworks. All 14 citations checked against primary sources: 0 fabricated, 8 corrected, 4 demoted. Key findings: (1) only calibrated scored decision-making transfers across domains (far transfer ~0.03-0.05 SD); (2) the durable core is a diagnostic router matching method to problem-type, not the frameworks themselves; (3) Meadows' leverage points - operators push weak ones (numbers) not strong ones (information flows, rules, goals); (4) frameworks are near-zero-cost commodities in a ~1B self-dev market; (5) design thinking works via psychological empowerment, not method mechanics. Build: thin top (router + scored decision journal), cheap swappable bottom (10-15 patterns). Missing 6th lens: the operator's own energy/attention is the rate-limiting resource.
